title: Tombow MONO Eraser XL (3-pack)
description_en: The Tombow MONO is the eraser that set the global standard for clean, residue-free erasing. Used in Japanese schools since 1969. Erases graphite and light ink without tearing paper.
description_ja: 1969年から続く定番消しゴム。消しカスがまとまりやすく、紙を傷めない。世界の消しゴムの基準を作ったトンボ鉛筆の代表作。
